item.title: A Timeline of Gracie Abrams & Paul Mescal’s Relationship
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest celebrity news and updates. Today, we're talking about one of the most buzzworthy couples in the entertainment industry: Gracie Abrams and Paul Mescal.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: So, let's start from the beginning. Gracie Abrams, a singer-songwriter, and Paul Mescal, an Irish actor, have a history that dates back years before they first stepped out in public together in 2024. What's interesting is that Mescal was a fan of Abrams' music even before she became a big name in pop.
[Music transitions to a slightly upbeat tone]
Host: Since they first interacted online, both Abrams and Mescal have been working hard on building their careers. Abrams has had multiple hits on the Billboard Hot 100, while Mescal has starred in major films like Aftersun, All of Us Strangers, and Gladiator II. In their personal lives, Abrams was briefly linked to DJ Hayes Bradely, and Mescal was in a long-term relationship with singer Phoebe Bridgers.
[Music returns to a softer tone]
Host: After keeping their relationship private for about a year, Abrams and Mescal started to share more moments together on social media and attend events as a couple. They even share a cozy home in London filled with musical instruments, where Mescal has been perfecting his portrayal of Paul McCartney for an upcoming Beatles biopic. Abrams has been impressed by Mescal's talent, saying he's "like an alien" when it comes to learning new skills.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's update on Gracie Abrams and Paul Mescal's relationship. We'll keep an eye on this adorable couple and bring you more news as it unfolds. Thanks for tuning in!
